title: A novel NbTaW0.5(Mo2C)x refractory high-entropy alloy with excellent mechanical properties
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting in a Ti-gettered argon atmosphere using pure elements of Nb, Ta, W (99.95 at%) and Mo2C powder (99.9 at%, 2-3 µm). The Mo2C powder was wrapped in tantalum foil and placed at the bottom. During arc melting, the ingots were flipped over and remelted at least eight times to ensure high chemical homogeneity. The annealed samples were kept at 1673 K for 12 h, cooled at 20 K/min to 1273 K, and finally furnace cooled to RT.
